GainsAll.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain over every compared model at the adaptive rule

GainsLeaveOneAttackOut.meaning: smallest mean gain left after dropping any single attack

GainsLeaveOneAttackOutAttack.meaning: the attack whose removal costs the gain the most

GainsPositiveDatasets.meaning: datasets whose mean paired gain is positive

GainsCifarOneZeroZero.meaning: mean paired gain on CIFAR-100 over 15 models

GainsCifarOneZero.meaning: mean paired gain on CIFAR-10 over 18 models

GainsGtsrb.meaning: mean paired gain on GTSRB over 15 models

GainsTiny.meaning: mean paired gain on Tiny ImageNet over 17 models

GainsSelectionHalfOurs.meaning: mean AUROC of the recommended placement on the selection half

GainsSelectionHalfTwin.meaning: mean AUROC of the branch-output twin on the selection half

GainsSelectionHalfTwinGap.meaning: paired AUROC gap, recommended minus twin, on the selection half

GainsReportHalfOurs.meaning: mean AUROC of the recommended placement on the report half

GainsReportHalfTwin.meaning: mean AUROC of the branch-output twin on the report half

GainsReportHalfTwinGap.meaning: paired AUROC gap, recommended minus twin, on the report half

GainsStrongAuroc.meaning: the AUROC called strong in the results

GainsStrongAttacks.meaning: attacks whose every model reads at least the strong AUROC under the recommended placement
